[P2] Preserve timeout identity through waitForCallback checkpoints

For a timed-out callback carrying `errorType = "States.Timeout"` inside `waitForCallback`, the callback now reports `CallbackTimeoutException`. However, `ChildContextOperation.handleChildContextFailure` explicitly bypasses `wrappedError` for `WAIT_FOR_CALLBACK`, so its context retains `States.Timeout` and reports `Timeout`. The live execution reports `CallbackTimeoutException`, while replay after child pruning reports `Timeout` through `ChildContextFailedException`. Previously these paths all retained `States.Timeout`. Apply equivalent failure-identity normalization to `WAIT_FOR_CALLBACK` checkpoints and add typed-timeout coverage for live execution and parent-only replay.
